subject: Five children sitting in grass between beach and hills, playing with traditional game pieces made from carved bone, throwing them to land in patterns, the pieces falling to create a perfect circle, their shadows stretching long in the morning sun.
action: Children aged 5-10 sit in grass. Each has handful of white carved bone game pieces passed down through generations. Take turns throwing pieces up. In grass around them, three types of natural stains visible - red ochre from cliff minerals, purple from berry juice on their hands, golden from egg yolk from breakfast. Stains slowly spreading through grass fibers toward game pieces. Children laugh and play, completely absorbed in their pattern game.
